owner.role: governance/compliance owner and creative director, acting jointly
owner.note: This artifact defines the character the entire pipeline exists to protect and express. No automated process may author or approve a change to it.

rules: Every change requires an explicit human-authored, human-approved edit to this file.
No tool, script, or generation/QA/ranking process may write to this file.
A change to hard_identity_continuity or safety_boundaries requires the same review rigor as a change to the identity reference authority artifact.
A change to behavioral_identity, viewer_relationship, movement_vocabulary, wardrobe_and_sensuality, environments, or prop_philosophy requires creative-director sign-off at minimum.
version must increment on any semantic change, together with a new authored_against_repository_revision and an updated created_at_utc reflecting the commit and time of that change.

authored_against_repository_revision records what repository state this artifact was designed against; it is never claimed to be a commit that contains this artifact, and downstream consumers must not treat it as such.

downstream consumers bind primarily to this file's own sha256, not to authored_against_repository_revision; a nonsemantic formatting edit still changes the sha256 and must invalidate any cached downstream binding unless the consumer explicitly regenerates its binding.
This artifact is considered stale and must be reviewed if pipeline/identity/lena_visual_reference_authority_v1.json's authoritative_traits change.

This artifact is considered stale and must be reviewed if pipeline/influencer_nodes/lena/persona.json's personality_contract traits or anti_traits change in a way that conflicts with behavioral_identity below.

A downstream consumer that finds its recorded doctrine_sha256 no longer matches this file's current sha256 must treat the doctrine as changed and re-validate before proceeding, not silently continue with a cached copy.
This artifact does not expire on a schedule; it is invalidated only by an explicit, reviewed edit to itself or to the two artifacts named above.

character_definition.framing: Lena is not primarily an editorial model posing for a broad audience. She creates a small personal moment with one person watching. Her existing identity consistency is a competitive advantage and must not be weakened by anything that expresses the qualities above.

hard_identity_continuity.note: This section restates, and never loosens, the continuity requirements already locked in the identity reference authority artifact. It does not replace that artifact and does not itself carry reference-image provenance.

behavioral_identity.consistency_rule: Behavioral identity must read as the same person across every scene, recipe, and environment. A single generation may vary in mood, but never in who Lena fundamentally is.

viewer_relationship.note: The viewer is addressed as a single person sharing a private moment with Lena, never as an anonymous broad audience being posed for.

movement_vocabulary.note: Lena should read as physically alive and mid-moment, not posed and static. This vocabulary is a menu of natural micro-actions, not a checklist every generation must satisfy.

wardrobe_and_sensuality.overriding_rule: Sensuality never overrides identity, anatomy, adult presentation, exposure limits, or platform safety. A high sensual-appeal reading can never excuse a hard identity, anatomy, exposure, or platform-safety failure.

environments.note: Scenes must be socially plausible, ordinary-access, and intimate in scale. They do not need to be narratively exhaustive or editorially elaborate.

safety_boundaries.note: This list is a restatement of the hard-failure boundary for this doctrine artifact. It does not replace, weaken, or override any existing QA, ranking, or safety mechanism defined elsewhere in the pipeline.

originality_boundary.note: Recipes, hooks, and captions built from this doctrine must describe a generic mechanic or premise, never reproduce a specific real creator's exact wording, format, or visual trade dress.
